description_expanded: Overview5.0(4 reviews)Gorgeous lake front 3-bedroom townhouse w/ golf cart. Short drive to the beach! SANDESTIN – 5199 Beachwalk Lakefront Townhouse | Golf Cart | Sleeps 10 DESCRIPTION Welcome to 5199 Beachwalk, a spacious 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom townhome in the Beachwalk Villa community of Sandestin. Perfect for family getaways, this lakefront retreat offers comfort, convenience, and easy access to the beach. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Enjoy serene lake views from the private deck or relax in the community’s heated pool. A short drive or a quick ride in the 6-seater golf cart gets you to the beach with ease. The resort tram provides additional transportation getting to the shore. HOME FEATURES 3 bedrooms | 3 bathrooms | Sleeps 10 Two master suites with scenic lake views Private balcony off the upstairs master suite Guest room with private courtyard access Cozy lakeside deck and spacious living area 6-seater golf cart & resort tram for easy beach access DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Walkable access to The Market Shops for dining & shopping With access to private beaches, golf courses, and tennis courts Proximity to the Hilton Sandestin Beach Golf Resort & Spa WHY STAY HERE? Ideal for families and group getaways Relaxing lakefront setting with resort-style amenities Convenient access to the beach, pools, and local attractions SLEEPING ACCOMODATIONS Two King master suites Queen guest bedroom Loft with two twin beds and two pop-up trundles 5199 Beachwalk is the perfect place to unwind and enjoy all that Sandestin has to offer! A security camera is installed on the property facing the golf cart. Tampering with the camera is strictly prohibited and will result in a $500 fine.Show less
